events.name: ItemClicked
events.description: Raised when an item placed directly on the strip is clicked. Items in drop-down menus raise their own Click events.
events.argumentsNote: e.ClickedItem is the item that was clicked.
events.useCase: Handle many top-level items in one place.

events.name: MenuActivate
events.description: Raised when the user activates the menu with the mouse or the Alt key.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Show a hint in the status bar while the menu is in use.

events.name: MenuDeactivate
events.description: Raised when the menu is no longer active.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.

events.name: Opening
events.description: Raised just before the menu is shown.
events.argumentsNote: Set e.Cancel = true to stop the menu from appearing.
events.useCase: Enable or hide items depending on the current state.

events.name: Opened
events.description: Raised after the menu has been displayed.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Log usage or move focus to the first item.

events.name: Closing
events.argumentsNote: e.CloseReason says why (ItemClicked, Keyboard, AppClicked...). Set e.Cancel = true to keep it open.
events.useCase: Find out why the menu closed, or keep it open for check-style items.

events.name: ItemClicked
events.description: Raised when an item in the menu is clicked.
events.argumentsNote: e.ClickedItem is the item that was clicked.
events.useCase: Handle every item of the menu in one handler.

events.name: ItemClicked
events.description: Raised when any item on the toolbar is clicked.
events.argumentsNote: e.ClickedItem is the item that was clicked.
events.useCase: Handle every toolbar button in one place.

events.name: ItemAdded
events.description: Raised after an item is added to the strip.
events.argumentsNote: e.Item is the item that was added.
events.useCase: Give every new item the same tooltip behavior.

events.name: ItemRemoved
events.description: Raised after an item is removed from the strip.
events.argumentsNote: e.Item is the item that was removed.
events.useCase: Update a counter or clean up resources.

events.name: ItemClicked
events.description: Raised when an item on the status bar is clicked.
events.argumentsNote: e.ClickedItem is the item that was clicked.
events.useCase: Let the user click a status item, such as the line number, to open a dialog.

events.name: Click
events.description: Raised when the toolbar button is clicked.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Run the command the button stands for.

events.name: CheckedChanged
events.description: Raised when Checked changes. Use it with CheckOnClick = true for toggle buttons.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Switch a formatting option on or off.

events.name: Click
events.description: Raised when the label is clicked. ToolStripLabel has no LinkClicked event, so handle Click when IsLink = true.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Open a web page from a link in the toolbar or status bar.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: Raised when the Text of the label changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: React when another part of the program updates the label.

events.name: SelectedIndexChanged
events.description: Raised when the selected item changes.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.

events.name: TextChanged
events.description: Raised when the text changes, including typing in a DropDown-style box.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Show what the user is typing.

events.name: DropDown
events.description: Raised when the drop-down list opens.
events.argumentsNote: No extra data. Use sender to find out which control raised the event.
events.useCase: Fill the list only when it is first needed.
